Executive Summary & Inferential Test Takeaways

Total company revenue reached $21,668,065.85, led by Fashion ($8.06M), Food ($7.11M), and Electronics ($6.50M). Delivery delays average 3.57 days. ANOVA ($F=0.2420, p=0.7851$) proves transit delay issues are network-wide rather than isolated to one city.

Critical Bottleneck: The Ibadan Fulfillment Deficit

Ibadan represents 26.2% of total customers (262 accounts), but SwiftLog operates 0 fulfillment warehouses in Ibadan! 100% of shipments to Ibadan cross state corridors from Lagos or Kano, directly driving a 63.8% delay rate.

Customer RFM Dynamics & Reverse Logistics Root Causes

The top 25% VIP Tier 1 accounts generate over 45% of total company revenue ($9.8M+). Out of 500 returns, 37% are caused solely by Late Delivery, meaning fixing transit bottlenecks eliminates over a third of reverse logistics costs.

Machine Learning Predictive Performance

Candidate Random Forest Delay Classifier achieves 62.4% Accuracy, 78.5% Recall, and 0.5244 ROC-AUC for pre-dispatch delay intervention. Demand Forecasting Gradient Boosting Regressor achieves 96.5% Accuracy ($R^2 = 0.9650$) with an MAE of only $286.14.

Top 5 Answers to Strategic Business Questions

1. Top Revenue Products: P040 ($191.5k), P085 ($187.4k), P186 ($180.9k).
2. Top Customer Accounts: C0263 ($74.1k, Lagos), C0815 ($70.2k, Ibadan), C0512 ($69.9k, Kano).
3. Best Performing Warehouses: W01 (58.7% delay rate), W10 (59.9%), W07 (60.4%).
4. Peak Demand Months: August (654 orders, $2.84M) and April (638 orders, $2.76M).
5. Highest Return SKUs: P032 (21.3% return rate), P017 (18.9%), P108 (18.3%).

Top 5 Executive Directives for Implementation

1. Commission an Ibadan Cross-Dock Hub: Eliminate transit delays for 26.2% of total customers and slash overall delay rates by 8.5%.
2. Deploy TMS Predictive Delay Rerouting: Use the Random Forest delay model to route shipments with probability >0.50 via express linehaul.
3. Automate Replenishment Orders for 380 Low-Stock SKUs: Auto-generate purchase orders to maintain mandatory safety buffers.
4. Establish VIP Enterprise Delivery SLAs: Protect $9.8M in revenue from the top 100 accounts with priority dispatch queues.
5. Scale Grounded GenAI Assistant: Deploy conversational AI across customer channels to automate 70% of tracking queries.
